units.source_text: “喏，请你好好看看我的身体，看看体形是不是走了样。

en.t: Here, please take a good look at my body and see whether my figure has lost its shape.

units.source_text: 昨天我的穿着太不好了。

en.t: What I was wearing yesterday was really too awful.

units.source_text: 相传你说要好好看看我清净的身子，这是爱猜疑的人的坏心眼。”

en.t: They say you wanted to take a good look at my pure body, but that is just the malicious thinking of someone who is suspicious by nature.
